satpm.publisher: Atmospheric Composition Analysis Group, Washington University in St. Louis (processed by Our World in Data)
satpm.title: SatPM: population-weighted PM2.5 exposure
satpm.notes: Annual average fine particulate matter (PM2.5) concentration people are exposed to, estimated from satellite observations, models and ground monitors, weighted by where people live. µg/m³.

who-sdg1162.publisher: World Health Organization via the UN SDG database (processed by Our World in Data)
who-sdg1162.title: SDG 11.6.2: annual mean levels of fine particulate matter in urban areas, population-weighted
who-sdg1162.notes: WHO's official estimate for urban areas (OWID indicator 1298167), 2023. Shown alongside SatPM for comparison; it covers cities and towns, not the whole country.

aqli.publisher: Energy Policy Institute at the University of Chicago (EPIC), Air Quality Life Index (processed by Our World in Data)
aqli.title: AQLI: population-weighted PM2.5 from human sources
aqli.notes: Annual population-weighted PM2.5 with natural sources such as desert dust and sea salt removed, µg/m³. The countries table's pm25_human column comes from this dataset, not from SatPM.

ihme-gbd2023.publisher: IHME, Global Burden of Disease Study 2023 (processed by Our World in Data)
ihme-gbd2023.title: Deaths attributed to air pollution
ihme-gbd2023.notes: Modelled estimates of deaths from all causes attributable to ambient particulate matter, household air pollution from solid fuels, and ambient ozone, 2023.

comeap-who-aqg.publisher: UK Committee on the Medical Effects of Air Pollutants (COMEAP)
comeap-who-aqg.title: Advice on health evidence relevant to setting PM2.5 targets: update (on the WHO 2021 guidelines)
comeap-who-aqg.notes: The WHO's 2021 guideline for annual average PM2.5 is 5 µg/m³; the previous guideline was 10.

who-factsheet.publisher: World Health Organization (via the Climate and Clean Air Coalition)
who-factsheet.title: Ambient air pollution factsheet

iqair-2025.title: 2025 World Air Quality Report: only 14% of cities meet WHO air pollution guideline
iqair-2025.notes: Ground monitor data from 9,446 cities in 143 countries, regions and territories.

natural-earth.title: Admin 0 countries, 1:110m
natural-earth.notes: Public domain. Used to match countries to map shapes.
